families.title: Scalar expressions
families.scope: Emitted SV precedence, casts, widths, and signedness
families.direct: Icarus execution vs independent widened arithmetic; selected integer-cast X/Z cases
families.remaining: No arbitrary expression grammar or symbolic wide-input proof

families.title: Indexed selects
families.scope: Emitted SV ascending, descending, and stepped reads
families.direct: Selected numeric and X/Z indices vs independent per-bit clipping
families.remaining: No arbitrary widths, selector expressions, or general conformance theorem

families.title: Four-state conditionals
families.scope: Conditional consensus against the independent IEEE model
families.bounds: Widths 1/2/65; exhaustive small values and selected wide patterns
families.direct: Analyzer/reference for every vector; Icarus for the corroborating subset
families.remaining: Common-Z disagreement excludes external comparisons only; it does not waive analyzer/reference checks

families.title: Cross-target expressions
families.scope: Analyzer, simulator, mapped-gate, and emitted-SV results
families.bounds: Operand widths independently 1–4; both signs; all input values
families.direct: Fixed grammar; output widths 1, max operand width, or max+1
families.remaining: No arbitrary grammar, four-state, wide-vector, or sequential guarantee

families.title: Cross-target sequential traces
families.scope: FF prior-state/pure-call and two-clock masked-RAM traces
families.bounds: Two-bit call fixture; three-instant histories; fixed RAM fixture
families.direct: Interpreter/JIT/AOT-C, mapped cells, and emitted SV vs independent state models
families.remaining: No arbitrary histories, X/Z, function side effects, metastability, CDC, or general RAM technology
